name: 95356 · Modesto, CA
findings: ZIP 95356 (Modesto) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95356 (Modesto) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
